A nested table flattened into a cell keeps its row boundaries as literal <br> when br_in_tables is enabled

```java title="Java"
import io.xberg.htmltomarkdown.*;

public final class Example {
    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        var optionsJson = "{\"br_in_tables\":true,\"compact_tables\":true}";
        var options = JsonUtil.fromJson(optionsJson, ConversionOptions.class);
        var result = HtmlToMarkdownRs.convert("<table><tr><td><p>Before</p><table><tr><th>ID</th><th>Status</th></tr><tr><td>123</td><td>Done</td></tr></table></td><td>Other</td></tr></table>", options);
        System.out.println(result.content());
    }
}
```
